crossRefs.note: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.

translations.web: All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
translations.bsb: All the posts around the courtyard shall have silver bands, silver hooks, and bronze bases.
